summary_markdown: The discussion centered on data handling after a facility changed networks. The initial plan was to reaggregate the cluster containing the affected facility and recalculate all metrics. [me] confirmed that if issues arose (e.g., model failure), it would be possible to surgically replace the hash without full reaggregation, but suggested attempting reaggregation first. When asked if the scope of potential failure was company-wide, [me] stated that either a partial or full reaggregation could be attempted.
decisions: Attempt cluster reaggregation for the affected facility's data.
action_items: Follow up later regarding technical assistance/help needed.
